title: Reject unsupported empty relation-block semirings
finding: TypedRelationBlock rejected unsupported semiring names only while validating stored scalar values. A direct empty CSR block had no values to validate and could therefore persist an arbitrary syntactically valid semiring_name despite having no executable canonical algebra behind that identity.
primary_claim: Every TypedRelationBlock now validates its persisted semiring identity against the same existing canonical reference-semiring resolver, including empty blocks. Supported empty Boolean, Natural, Tropical, and Evidence-DAG blocks remain valid; unsupported names fail closed before CSR retention.
gardener_decision: Reuse the existing canonical reference-semiring resolver for constructor-time identity validation rather than duplicating the supported-name list or adding a registry. The resolver accepts either a protocol backend selector or an already-validated persisted name; no second semantic authority is introduced.
acceptance: an empty direct relation block with an unsupported semiring_name fails closed
a supported empty boolean block remains valid and uses canonical Boolean zero semantics
unknown non-empty persisted semiring values remain fail-closed
supported alternate backend objects remain selectors only and cannot redefine named algebra
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.

rollback: Revert G1-TENSOR-01AO; Forest/Fourfold artifacts, identities, and authority are unchanged.
